name: kohakublueleaf/tokenomos
title: Tokenomos is now open source: a rewritten serving frontend that gets small models several times past vLLM on one RTX 5090
summary: KohakuBlueleaf published the Tokenomos repo. It keeps vLLM's model code but replaces the scheduler and KV-cache/state manager used for continuous batching, so the CPU stops being the bottleneck; he reports small-model inference several times faster even at batch size 512 on an RTX 5090, says it also helps 30B models, and that it runs on Windows and older sm75 GPUs. Earlier 3x claim was kept on Oct
